svg.aria-label: GPU occupancy over time for the same eight passes. With one barrier per batch the occupancy drains at every barrier. With split barriers, far passes fill the gaps, so occupancy stays high and the work finishes earlier. Bands show which pass holds which share of the GPU.
svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: GPU occupancy with and without split barriers
Illustrative. Each band is one pass, stacked in launch order. Colors are batches 0 to 3, dashed bands are far passes, red is unused GPU.
